public_gates: M243 per-row exact M232 objective audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run more PPO before the audit
do not promote M243 because M223 improves
do not ignore protected-key row movement
hypothesis: M243 improves the old M223 rows while regressing the combined M232 objective because the protected-key component moves in the wrong direction. A per-row exact audit should identify whether the next repair needs protected-key reweighting, a separate protected-key loss, or a stricter lexicographic objective gate.
success_criteria: compute per-row exact objective deltas for M239 to M243
separate M223-row movement from protected-key movement
decide one bounded next repair before any more PPO
keep M239 alpha 0.5 as current public-gate base
failure_criteria: collapse M223 and protected-key objective movement into one aggregate

commands.name: m244_audit
commands.command: Use exact per-row objective calculations to identify whether M243's M232 regression is dominated by the protected-key row or distributed across M223 rows.

decision_rule: M244 may only unblock more PPO if it explains the protected-key/objective conflict and pre-registers one bounded repair path.
